import __vite__cjsImport3_react_jsxDevRuntime from "/node_modules/.vite/deps/react_jsx-dev-runtime.js?v=1c971064";
const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
function formatDate(value) {
	return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
		dateStyle: "medium",
		timeStyle: "short"
	}).format(new Date(value));
}
function App() {
	const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState("new-user");
	const [personName, setPersonName] = useState("");
	const [position, setPosition] = useState("");
	const [officeDivision, setOfficeDivision] = useState("");
	const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
	const [userMatches, setUserMatches] = useState([]);
	const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
	const [positions, setPositions] = useState([]);
	const [memories, setMemories] = useState([]);
	const [editingMemoryId, setEditingMemoryId] = useState("");
	const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
	const [error, setError] = useState("");
	const completedCount = useMemo(() => positions.filter((positionItem) => positionItem.status === "completed").length, [positions]);
	const pageTitle = activePage === "new-user" ? "New User" : "Find User";
	const normalizedSearch = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
	const visibleUsers = normalizedSearch ? userMatches : memories;
	const savedPositions = useMemo(() => {
		const values = memories.map((memory) => memory.content?.position).filter(Boolean);
		return [...new Set(values)].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
	}, [memories]);
	const savedOfficeDivisions = useMemo(() => {
		const values = memories.map((memory) => memory.content?.officeDivision || memory.content?.source).filter(Boolean);
		return [...new Set(values)].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
	}, [memories]);
	async function refreshData() {
		const [nextPositions, nextMemories] = await Promise.all([fetch(`${apiUrl}/jobs`), fetch(`${apiUrl}/memories`)]);
		if (!nextPositions.ok || !nextMemories.ok) {
			throw new Error("Could not load saved data.");
		}
		setPositions(await nextPositions.json());
		setMemories(await nextMemories.json());
	}
	function resetForm() {
		setPersonName("");
		setPosition("");
		setOfficeDivision("");
		setEditingMemoryId("");
	}
	function startEditing(user) {
		setEditingMemoryId(user.id);
		setPersonName(user.content?.name ?? "");
		setPosition(user.content?.position ?? "");
		setOfficeDivision(user.content?.officeDivision ?? user.content?.source ?? "");
		setActivePage("new-user");
	}
	async function submitUser(event) {
		event.preventDefault();
		setIsSubmitting(true);
		setError("");
		const payload = {
			name: personName,
			position,
			officeDivision,
			submittedAt: new Date().toISOString()
		};
		try {
			const response = await fetch(editingMemoryId ? `${apiUrl}/memories/${editingMemoryId}` : `${apiUrl}/jobs`, {
				method: editingMemoryId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
				headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
				body: JSON.stringify(editingMemoryId ? { updates: {
					name: personName,
					position,
					officeDivision
				} } : { payload })
			});
			if (!response.ok) {
				const body = await response.json();
				throw new Error(body.error ?? (editingMemoryId ? "Could not update user." : "Could not save user."));
			}
			await refreshData();
			resetForm();
		} catch (caughtError) {
			setError(caughtError.message);
		} finally {
			setIsSubmitting(false);
		}
	}
	function openSearchResults(event) {
		event.preventDefault();
		setActivePage("find-user");
	}
	useEffect(() => {
		refreshData().catch((caughtError) => setError(caughtError.message));
		const timer = setInterval(() => {
			refreshData().catch((caughtError) => setError(caughtError.message));
		}, 3e3);
		return () => clearInterval(timer);
	}, []);
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!normalizedSearch) {
			setUserMatches([]);
			setIsSearching(false);
			return undefined;
		}
		const controller = new AbortController();
		const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
			setIsSearching(true);
			try {
				const response = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/users/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(normalizedSearch)}`, { signal: controller.signal });
				if (!response.ok) {
					throw new Error("Could not search users.");
				}
				setUserMatches(await response.json());
			} catch (caughtError) {
				if (caughtError.name !== "AbortError") {
					setError(caughtError.message);
				}
			} finally {
				setIsSearching(false);
			}
		}, 250);
		return () => {
			controller.abort();
			clearTimeout(timer);
		};
	}, [normalizedSearch]);
